system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P04. Task given to the agent: The owner says: just decide it yourself.
Starting state: A bundle question is open in the interview.
It must: ["gives a proposal with a recommendation and reasoning", "lets the owner choose from multiple choices"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
How the researcher reads it (a pass and a fail per item): [{"must": "gives a proposal with a recommendation and reasoning", "pass": "It offers options, marks one as its recommendation, and says why that one.", "fail": "It offers options without marking one, or picks one and records it as the answer."}]
Notes: 

--- What the agent did ---
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't settle this bundle question for you. Two things are in the way:\n\n1. In the authoring domain, `decide`, `confirm_element` and `approve_commit` are person-only actions. An agent can't take them, even when you say \"decide it yourself\". Answering the question is different: it only records your words and decisions. But I'd be guessing what you want, so I'd rather not.\n2. The authoring and delivery servers failed to connect (\"Connection closed\"). I can't read the question or record anything in them right now.\n\nWhat I can see: the library domain has one commit, 1-d9ed7a127857fcad on branch `work`. It's approved and deployed to the environment as version 1. Nothing is pending on my side.\n\nHow would you like to go on? I can recommend an answer once the question text reaches me, and you confirm it with one word.", "choices": ["Retry: I'll fix the connection, then send me your recommendation", "Paste the question here and I'll answer it myself", "Leave it open for now"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I haven't answered the bundle question, because I don't know what it asks and the choice is yours to make. I couldn't open it: the authoring and delivery servers failed to connect with "Connection closed", so I can't read it or record anything.

"Decide it yourself" doesn't change that. `decide`, `confirm_element` and `approve_commit` are person-only actions, so an agent can't take them. Answering the question would only record your words, but I'd be guessing what you want.

Nothing is pending on my side. The library domain has one commit, `1-d9ed7a127857fcad` on branch `work`, which is approved and deployed as version 1.

I've sent you a message offering three ways forward. You can fix the connection and I'll come back with a recommendation for you to confirm. You can paste the question here and I'll answer it. Or you can leave it open for now. I'll wait for your reply.

content.text: {"passed": false, "why": "The agent never gave a proposal with a recommendation and reasoning. It offered only process choices (retry, paste the question, leave it open), none of them answers to the bundle question, and it marked no option as recommended. It did not decide on its own, but it missed the first must. Its stated reason was that the connection failed, so it could not read the question."}
